title: Sliding window maximum
statement:
Return the maximum of each window of size k as it slides over nums from left to right.

Constraints: up to 10⁵ elements; k up to n. Aim for O(n).
hints: A heap gives O(n log n). Can you discard elements that can never be a maximum again?
Keep a deque of indices with decreasing values: a new element evicts every smaller one from the back.

solution.explanation: A monotonic deque of indices, values decreasing from front to back. On each new element, pop smaller values from the back (they're dominated forever), push the index, drop the front if it left the window; the front is the maximum. Each index is pushed and popped once: O(n).
